value.rationale: Pre-normalization is a mathematically motivated implementation component explicitly included in the motivating method, not an arbitrary parameter slice. The theorem shows it changes the critical convergence exponent (relative to no pre-normalization), sharp safe fixed-step frontier, superlinear local order, cycle bifurcation exponent, and regularizes a whole neutral sign-cycle family into one locally attracting orbit. These exact limiting effects supply a deterministic benchmark for choosing and interpreting the normalization floor.
